name: stress-ng pipe
description: Start N workers that perform large pipe writes and reads to exercise pipe I/O. This exercises memory write and reads as well as context switching. Each worker has two processes, a reader and a writer. The score is the total bogo operations per second (in real time) based on wall clock run time.

environment_fields.measured_at: Timestamp (UTC) of finishing the benchmark run.
environment_fields.kernel_version: Linux kernel version of the server running the benchmark (not recorded for managed databases).
